name: scorebug
description: Live scores beside the chat: a card for each game in a side column of the scene in the desktop app, one row above the prompt everywhere else.

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Off draws nothing and runs no timer.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: The teams to follow, comma-separated: a short code, a whole name or one word of it. Empty follows every game the feed has. Twenty at most.

source.title: Feed
source.description: Where the scores come from. demo: two pretend games that play on the clock, to see the cards before a real feed is chosen; it sends nothing anywhere.

refresh.title: Refresh while a game is on (seconds)
refresh.description: How often the feed is read while a followed game is on. With none on it is read before the next starts, at least every fifteen minutes; after a failure the wait doubles, up to five minutes.

side.title: Column
side.description: Which side column of the scene the cards stand in, in the desktop app.

band.title: Row above the prompt
band.description: auto: shown where no card can be, in the terminal, on the phone and in the desktop app with no scene behind the chat. on: always. off: never.

alerts.title: Toasts
alerts.description: A toast when a followed team scores a goal or a run, and when a followed game ends.
